title: Unpinning a technician puts them back where they were
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the build under test as a dispatcher whose role has Work Orders view and Work Orders create and edit (check: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > on the Work Orders card, View and Create & Edit are both ticked. The Admin role has both).
  2. In the top bar, choose the location you test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty"). Every technician and work order below belongs to this location.
  3. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (the display switcher only shows at 1024 px and wider).
  4. The location has these eligible technicians (examples): "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha", "ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo", "ZZAUTOTEST Cal Charlie", "ZZAUTOTEST Dan Delta".
    • A staff member counts as a technician when, in Settings > Staff > open the staff member > Edit Staff Member, they are Active, the Time Clock (clockable) setting is on, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location.
    • To add one: Settings > Staff > add a staff member with those settings (e.g. first name "ZZAUTOTEST Ana", last name "Alpha").
  5. No technician is pinned and your technician order is the starting one: Ana, Ben, Cal, Dan.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders from the top menu and click the All tab.
  2. Click Board View in the display switcher (the design tooltip reads "Board").
  3. Pin Cal (pin button "Pin column" in his header). Read the column order.
  4. Unpin Cal (the same button, now "Unpin column"). Read the column order.
  5. Click Tech View in the display switcher at the right of the toolbar (the design tooltip reads "By Lead Tech").
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: Cal moves to the pinned area: Unassigned, Cal, Ana, Ben, Dan.
  • Step 4: Cal returns to his previous place: Unassigned, Ana, Ben, Cal, Dan.
  • Step 5: Tech View shows the same order.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; Work Orders Board View & Tech View Display Options Technical Implementation Plan (revised 24 Sep 2026, uploaded 8 Oct 2026), section 1.4 (SQ-11), confirmed by Sasha Grosman in the PRD footer comment of 24 Sep 2026. Epic SV-10043; story SV-10046 (Story 3, Board View); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S3-R19, read 8 Oct 2026. Review Decisions SQ-11 (29 Sep 2026) still lists the unpin position as open (PO question raised).
